def solution():
    # Bradley's EUR exposure and the forward rates
    euro_amount = 200_000 * 90
    initiation_forward_bid = 1.3935 - 19.0 / 10_000
    three_month_forward_ask = 1.4210 - 21.0 / 10_000

    # Value of the short-EUR forward when closed after three months

    # return answer
